Crime & Law · India

Supreme Court questions High Court rape definition; other legal news

The Supreme Court has expressed disapproval of a High Court order that suggested removing a woman's salwar and pressing her chest did not constitute an attempt to rape. Separately, the Delhi Police filed a chargesheet in a rape-murder case, while various High Courts addressed issues including pregnancy termination for a minor, land records and citizenship, and divorce decrees. Other reports detail probes into alleged sexual assault and conversion cases.
